title: Conclusion
coreMove: Keep a long commitment while knowing when values, fit, or opportunity cost justify quitting.
sourcePressure: Put grit in proportion: develop it, use it, but do not mistake it for all of character.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Thinking grit is the only virtue or that quitting is always failure.

sourceAnchors.name: Ta-Nehisi Coates
sourceAnchors.detail: Coates won a MacArthur Genius Grant after years of struggle and describes writing as repeated failure refined over time.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Coates makes genius look like revision marks accumulating until the page can finally stand.

sourceAnchors.name: MacArthur Genius Grant
sourceAnchors.detail: The conclusion returns to the idea of genius through the grant and reframes excellence as sustained improvement rather than effortless brilliance.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The grant matters because the label genius arrives after the unglamorous repetitions it hides.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps
